verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents A/B experiments whose results are read with a built-in Bayesian statistics engine. It also offers an official MCP server and an Admin API that give agents programmatic access to multivariate flag configurations. However, no evidence explicitly shows experiment results or statistics exposed through the API or MCP; only the broad claim that anything in the dashboard can be done via the Admin API implies it. missing for 10: documented programmatic API/MCP access to experiment results and statistics, an agent-oriented summarization or ship/rollback recommendation workflow, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can read experiment configurations and results programmatically to summarize outcomes and recommend ship/rollback decisions

citations.quote: serve variations of a feature with a multivariate flag, collect events from your application into a managed data warehouse, and read the results with a built-in Bayesian statistics engine.
Anything you can do in the Flagsmith dashboard, you can also do via the Admin API.
Your assistant can manage feature flags, segments, multivariate options, and release workflows on your behalf
The Flagsmith MCP Server gives AI assistants and agents programmatic access to the Flagsmith Admin API through the Model Context Protocol
